name: Akebi
source:
A sexy guy.

[SPOILER]Akebi is a bizarre and perverted man who cross-dresses as a schoolgirl, and is somehow able to attend classes without arousing suspicion. He's a comically stereotypical "oyaji"; being an overweight and balding middle-aged man who enjoys mah-jong, sake and [URL=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pachinko]pachinko[/URL]. Akebi is likely a problem gambler based on the events of the sequel, "Suki na Otoko no Ko?"[/SPOILER]
